meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫一遍热门短篇榜单,看清哪些题材正在起量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你写短篇网文,想快速判断该跟什么题材
copy.tagline_en: Scan trending short-story charts to see which genres are heating up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web fiction and want to know which genres are trending

howto.what: Claude 会当短篇网文市场分析师：分析你指定平台的热门短篇榜单，产出扫榜报告（情绪热度、题材热点、风口预警、值得写的方向），并做选题匹配，结果写进本地文件。
howto.when: 当你说出「/story-short-scan」「/短篇扫榜」「短篇什么火」等指令时触发。

say.note: Claude 先确认平台和想写的方向

say.text: 短篇什么火？给我全榜概览
say.note: 没定方向时做全榜概览找趋势

say.text: 帮我对比知乎盐言和七猫短篇
say.note: 没有脚本的平台需要你提供榜单截图

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-story web-fiction market analyst: it scans the rankings of the platform you pick, produces a scan report (emotion heat, topic hotspots, trend warnings, directions worth writing), and does topic matching, writing results to local files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use commands such as /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or ask 「短篇什么火」 (what's hot in short fiction) etc.

say_en.text: Scan the Dianzhong short-story rankings for me
say_en.note: Claude first confirms platform and focus

say_en.text: What's hot in short fiction? Give me an overview
say_en.note: With no focus set, it does a full-rank overview

say_en.text: Compare Zhihu Yanyan and Qimao short stories
say_en.note: Platforms without scripts need your screenshots
